entities.summary: Romantic music is a stylistic movement in Western Classical music associated with the period of the 19th century commonly referred to as the Romantic era. It is closely related to the broader concept of Romanticism—the intellectual, artistic, and literary movement that became prominent in Western culture from about 1798 until 1837. Romantic music is a music genre. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
